notes.title: Tomb of the Overlord - Demo out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Demo for Tomb of the Overlord is out now.
I hope you take some time to enjoy it with your friends!

I think there is quite a bit of content here for a demo, quite a few secrets to find and classes to unlock.

This might be more of an alpha then a demo though. Since almost everything is subject to change. but the core concepts for the game are there! please feel free to join the discord on the steam page if you have feedback!

Kind regards, Richard

notes.title: Tomb of the Overlord – Built for Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557390/45c07ebed40a8f0eb48e67e797b5362242d735e8.png[/img]

[b]Tomb of the Overlord[/b] Feels Right at Home on Steam Deck:
🎮 Seamless Controls – Designed with gamepad input in mind, everything feels natural on the Deck.
⚔️ Optimized Performance – We’ve fine-tuned the game to hit 60 FPS, even in the heat of battle.
☁️ Cloud Saves – Switch between PC and Steam Deck without losing progress.
🕹️ Pick Up and Play – Quick quests, fast combat, and no downtime—perfect for gaming on the go.

Whether you're slashing through waves of skeletons or choosing your next path through the graveyard, Tomb of the Overlord was made to feel incredible on Steam Deck.

💀 Grab your weapons, rally your allies, and take the fight to the Overlord—anytime, anywhere! 💀
